1) **AUB autopilot (module-level)**

- If you see **evaluation errors / missing files**, share the traceback + the referenced config path(s) and I can help pinpoint the misconfiguration quickly.

  - run IDs / output directories

  - any instability warnings (timeouts, nondeterminism)
